button: defaults, attribute to property, property to attribute, invalid enum falls back
button: label, start and end slots are projected; the control part is exposed
button: focus goes to the inner button (delegatesFocus) and a disabled button swallows clicks
button: type=submit submits and type=reset resets the surrounding form

card: an actions child reveals the header and a footer child reveals the footer (slotchange)
card: tone reflects and the ::part hook and custom properties style the shadow tree
tabs: first tab is selected, panels follow, roving tabindex and aria wiring are set
tabs: clicking selects, emits a composed cancelable event, and preventDefault keeps the old tab
tabs: arrow keys, Home and End move focus and select; disabled tabs are skipped
tabs: manual activation moves focus but selects only on click
switch: toggles, emits change, and reflects checked
switch: takes part in the form (value when on, absent when off), resets and follows a disabled fieldset
switch: exposes the switch role to assistive technology and is named by its label
strict CSP: no element carries a style attribute or style element, and styles are adopted sheets
theme: tokens inherit into shadow roots, so a data-theme ancestor restyles the component

tabs: count badge, close button event, only=phone hidden on desktop, trailing slot
tabs: none-active selects nothing and every choice raises the event; scroll mode fades the edge with more tabs
mounting 200 buttons is fast enough to be unnoticeable
tooltip: focus shows it, the target is described by a light-DOM node, Escape hides it
tooltip: a hint card draws its own help button, a touch tap toggles it, and its links live in the panel
popover: a click on the trigger opens it, Escape closes it and returns focus, confirm fires pk-confirm
popover: a cancelable pk-close lets the host veto closing
dropdown: opens, arrows and typeahead move focus, checkbox toggles and reports, Escape returns focus to the trigger
dropdown: a submenu opens with Right and closes with Left
context menu: contextmenu opens it at the pointer; choosing an item closes it
select-menu: reads its options, opens, chooses with the keyboard, reports pk-change and joins the form
drawer: open reflects to a native modal dialog; Escape asks first and can be vetoed; a backdrop click closes unless persistent
drawer: docked is non-modal, sits inside its positioned ancestor, and Escape still asks before closing
drawer: sides, the wide flag and the actions slot are part of the API
dialog: the backdrop never closes it; Escape and the close button do; confirm resolves a promise
toast: kind sets its role, the timer dismisses it, hover pauses it
toast stack: shows at most max toasts and reveals the next as one is dismissed
alert: role follows the kind and dismiss hides it unless vetoed
loading overlay: busy makes the content inert and announces the label
breadcrumb: a long trail folds the middle crumbs behind a button that expands them
stepper: states follow current; a linear stepper blocks skipping ahead; events are cancelable
toc: lists the headings of its target with generated ids and marks the current one
side nav: filter shows matches and opens their branch, tree keys walk the rows, the rail marks items
side nav: collapsed state and open branches persist under the persist key
nav item: a branch button toggles expanded; current and disabled set ARIA on the row
command palette: opens on Ctrl+K, filters as you type, Enter fires pk-select with the item and records a recent
lightbox: shows the item at an index, steps with wrap-around, refuses unsafe sources
navbar: the hamburger toggles open and Escape closes it; app shell toggles its nav drawer
scroll aids: progress starts at 0, back-to-top is hidden until scrolled, the skip link points at a same-page fragment
pager and step render their slots
skeleton: text variant sets the line count, circle and block take a size, the label is for assistive tech
spinner: is a status region with a label, and each variant shows only its own shape
progress: native bar carries value and max, shows the percentage, goes indeterminate and colours by threshold
badge: caps a count, lets the slot win, and dot mode shows the dot
tag: remove button fires a cancelable pk-remove with the value, and removes the tag unless cancelled
avatar: initials, a stable colour slot, an accessible name with status; the group hides overflow and shows +N
pagination: renders a window with ellipses, next and page buttons emit a cancelable pk-page, and the select changes the size
table: renders rows from JSON attributes, sorts on a header click with aria-sort, and a cancelled pk-sort leaves the order
table: manual mode shows rows as given and only reports; selection, bulk bar, filter event, loading and empty states
table: slotted-table mode frames a raw table, hides its own table, and flow drops the scroll container
table: filters and sorts locally when not manual, and a slotted cell replaces the text
stat: shows the change with an arrow, sign, colour and spoken form; an href makes one link; a sparkline draws
empty-state: hides what is not given, exposes the heading level, and announces when asked
field-list: hides an empty heading and lays dt and dd out as a grid
field-list: a page re-flows the columns through --pk-field-list-columns without touching the shadow root
card: media slot shows only when used, horizontal lays out in a row, href adds one link
timeline: list role on the feed, listitem on each item, and a time element
list-group: rows become list items and an actionable row marks the current one
accordion: an item toggles its details and reports it; exclusive closes the others
tree: roving focus, arrow keys, expand and collapse, selection and aria attributes
chart: draws a labelled svg from the table, adds a legend for several series, keeps the table, and takes a data property
code-block: one line per source line with numbers, wrap toggle and a copy result
calendar: shows the month, selects a day with a cancelable event, moves with keys and pages months
divider, media and hint: separator role, ratio and lightbox event, and a hint that toggles in flow
gallery: attributes narrow the framed view, theme and width apply, a changed attribute reloads it, the frame follows the content height
gallery: chrome full keeps the contents nav, cut down to the requested control
input: typing updates value, reports input and change, and the form receives it
input: required and pattern set validity through ElementInternals; invalid reflects to aria-invalid
input: clear button, password reveal and the number stepper

textarea: value, form entry and reset; autogrow reflects
select: option children become the choices, value and change flow, multiple submits one entry each
field: hands label, description and error to the control; counter follows the value; required marks the control

checkbox: toggles, submits its value only when checked, resets, and a master mirrors its group with the mixed state

range: single value and fill; dual keeps low below high and submits two entries
rating: stars are radios, choosing sets value, readonly is an image with a text alternative
combobox: typing filters, arrows and Enter pick, Escape closes; blur reverts stray text; select mode uses the trigger and typeahead
tag-input: Enter and separators add, duplicates and the limit are refused, Backspace and the cross remove, the form gets one entry per tag
otp-input: typing advances, a pasted or autofilled code spreads, Backspace steps back, completion is an event
colour-input: the swatch and hex field stay in step, short hex is expanded, junk is invalid
dropzone: accepted files are listed and submitted, rejected ones get a reason, Remove drops a file
button: busy ignores clicks without losing focus, a toggle flips pressed and reports it, icon and block reflect
button-group: single mode keeps exactly one toggle pressed
split-button: the caret opens the menu, arrows and Escape work, choosing reports and closes
switch: invalid, size and label position reflect and the invalid ring shows
form-section and form-actions: heading, description and status render from props and slots
select: a value set from outside (a Blazor re-render) moves the inner select
dropzone: with an input in the input slot the zone only draws the target and drops go into that input
combobox: typing reports the query even when the client filters, and an option refresh keeps the filter
field and checkbox: inline layout, small size and the checkbox custom properties reflect
code explorer module: mounts a snapshot object, opens the requested file and runs the search

page-header: the title is a heading at the chosen level, slots land in their parts, and empty rows are hidden
page-header: section and record variants reflect, and a pk-breadcrumb slots in above the title
page-header: on a narrow container the actions take the full width and are touch sized

toolbar: heading and note render, actions hide when empty, and it stacks on a narrow container
cluster: a horizontal row wraps at the container edge, nowrap keeps one line, and the gap is the default token
cluster: every gap value maps to its spacing token, and align, justify and vertical map to the flex properties
cluster: the hidden attribute hides it
stack: children stack vertically with the gap token, stretch by default, and align changes the cross axis
stack: dividers draw a rule above every child but the first
grid: auto-fit equal columns of at least min, at two widths, down to one column on a phone
grid: columns caps the count, an unparseable min is ignored, and the default min applies without one
grid: still fills its container inside a flex row (a shrink-to-fit parent must not collapse it)
icon: the use href is an absolute URL to the SDK sprite and the symbol exists there; a label makes it an image, none hides it
local time: writes the instant in the given locale and zone inside a time element, falls back to the slot, and relative reads as words
field: a label-action slot sits beside the label, shows even without a label, and clicking it does not focus the control

workspace: without a nav there is no nav tab and no column; with no aside the strip is not needed
workspace: fill takes the height of its parent and drops the frame; without it the height is a viewport share
